captureFAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions

captureFAQ.a2: Dual architecture: your current checkout stays active in parallel. Our optimized checkout works simultaneously. Progressive testing 20% → 50% → 100% of traffic. Instant rollback if needed.
captureFAQ.q3: Is it compatible with my store?
captureFAQ.a3: Yes, if you're on Standard with revenue > €50K/year and traffic > 1000 visitors/month. We'll audit your store for free to confirm compatibility.
captureFAQ.a4: You choose: Option 1 = €0 upfront, then 2% per sale (funded by additional revenue). Option 2 = €2990 once, then 0% forever (ROI observed in 4-12 weeks). Additional revenue can help fund your future Plus upgrade.
captureFAQ.a5: We're the first checkout optimization platform designed specifically for merchants scaling toward Plus. Test advanced checkout features during your growth phase, and use the additional revenue to prepare for your Plus upgrade.
